## Où j'en suis
The ACS endpoint now verifies SAML signatures using signxml instead of python3-saml, with custom logic for audience, recipient, and condition validation (120s clock skew) plus Redis-based replay protection. All checks, formatting, and typing are resolved, and the changes have been merged. The focus now shifts to coordinating the staging environment setup for the client demo.

- [en-cours] PR #412 is merged on main; verification uses signxml with a strict 120s skew tolerance and replay guard.
- [prochaine-étape] Load Fernhill's staging IdP metadata and provide our SP metadata to their IT team by Wednesday EOD for Thursday's demo.
- [essai-raté] Building python3-saml with xmlsec on Alpine failed repeatedly due to libxml2 version mismatches and missing crypto libraries.
- [décision] Drop python3-saml entirely and enforce a maximum 120s timestamp skew to match Fernhill's security contract (source: t12)
